title: Trusting God in Our Work
summaryZh: 求神帶領工作中的會議，賜下智慧和清晰的異象，並在一切事上榮耀祂。
lines: God, I pray over this meeting I have coming up.
神啊，我為這場即將到來的會議禱告。
Thank you in advance that you are already on the other side of these conversations, and for leading our team in the direction we should go in.
預先感謝祢，因為祢已經在這些對話的另一端，並帶領我們的團隊走在我們該走的方向上。
Help us to ask the questions you want to answer and tune our ears to hear your voice.
幫助我們問出祢想回答的問題，並調整我們的耳朵來聽祢的聲音。
Empower us through your Spirit to communicate our thoughts and ideas effectively and kindly.
藉著祢的靈賦予我們能力，使我們能有效且友善地溝通我們的想法和點子。
Teach us to be quick to listen and slow to defensiveness.
教導我們快快地聽，慢慢地起防衛心。
I ask for a clear vision and a way forward, and I believe that your word is a lamp to our feet and a light to our path.
我求一個清晰的異象和前進的道路，並且我相信祢的話是我們腳前的燈，是我們路上的光。
May our team continue to honor and glorify you in all we do.
願我們的團隊在我們所做的一切事上繼續尊榮並榮耀祢。
We love you and thank you for trusting us with this work.
我們愛祢，並感謝祢將這份工作託付給我們。
